line: I ain’t leave the streets yet, I’m still in Philly
vault_lines: I ain't leave the streets yet, I'm still in Philly (Philly)
meaning: Matt Ox is from Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. This line suggests how Matt won’t leave his “streets” (hometown) yet since it means so much to him.

line: It’s the Dart gang, boy, don’t be a target (Dart gang shit, man)
vault_lines: It's the Dart gang, boy, don't be a target (Dart gang shit, man)
meaning:
He said “Dart Gang” which is in memory of friend Dart who died in 2011 from heart failure. Chief Keef has mentioned Dart Gang many times in the past such as in his song “Bussin” he says

Dart gang come through flipping shit like Jessie Jackson

line: I heard your trap slow, it’s a lightyear like Buzz (Bitch)
vault_lines: I heard your trap slow, it's a lightyear like Buzz (Bitch)
meaning: Sosa’s heard that an unnamed drug dealer has had a slow year and has been unable to sell much product and thus not generated much revenue. He compares this to Buzz Lightyear, a fictional Space Ranger toy from the Toy Story franchise.
